answer: Honeypot grading resists sybils: salt the grading stream with canary items whose correct verdict is secretly known — answers engineered to be clearly bad. An honest grader rejects them; a rubber-stamping sybil that approves everything to farm alignment rewards trips the trap. Each canary is a hidden beacon, indistinguishable from real work until scored, so a ring cannot pre-filter it. Approving a planted bad answer is a ferrous stain that slashes the identity's bond, and the umber mass of lazy clones is exposed one trap at a time. Precondition: canaries stay unpredictable.
